arxiv-2109-09597.title: Two Approaches to Building Collaborative, Task-Oriented Dialog Agents through Self-Play
arxiv-2109-09597.creator: Arkady Arkhangorodsky, Scot Fang, Victoria Knight
arxiv-2109-09597.description: Abstract Task-oriented dialog systems are often trained on human/human dialogs, such as collected from Wizard-of-Oz interfaces. However, human/human corpora are frequently too small for supervised training to be effective. This paper investigates two approaches to training agent-bots and user-bots through self-play, in which they autonomously explore an API environment, discovering communication strategies that enable them to solve the task.

arxiv-2201-07769.title: Orbital magnetization of Floquet topological systems
arxiv-2201-07769.creator: Gabriel E. Topp 1, Päivi Törmä 1, Dante M. Kennes 2,3, Aditi Mitra 4
arxiv-2201-07769.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Gabriel E. Topp 1, Päivi Törmä 1, Dante M. Kennes 2,3, Aditi Mitra 4. A general expression for the orbital magnetization of a Floquet system is derived. The expression holds for a clean system, and is valid for any driving protocol, and arbitrary occupation of the bands. The orbital magnetization is shown to be large not only for Chern insulators, but also for anomalous phases where the Chern number does not fully account for the topology.

arxiv-2209-15102.title: Thurston’s Theorem: Entropy in Dimension One
arxiv-2209-15102.creator: Ryan Dickmann, George Domat, Thomas Hill, Sanghoon Kwak, Carlos Ospina, Priyam Patel, Rebecca Rechkin
arxiv-2209-15102.description: Abstract . In his paper [ 13 ] , Thurston shows that a positive real number h h is the topological entropy for an ergodic traintrack representative of an outer automorphism of a free group if and only if its expansion constant λ = e h \lambda=e^{h} is a weak Perron number.

arxiv-2210-16783.title: On the limiting extremal vanishing for configuration spaces
arxiv-2210-16783.creator: by
arxiv-2210-16783.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by by. We study the limiting behavior of extremal cohomology groups of k k -points configuration spaces of complex projective spaces of complex dimension m ≥ 4 . In the previous work, we prove that the extremal cohomology groups of degrees ( 2 ​ m − 2 ) ​ k + i (2m-2)k+i are eventually vanish for each i ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 } .

arxiv-2309-00699.title: Geometric Deep Learning: a Temperature Based Analysis of Graph Neural Networks
arxiv-2309-00699.creator: Lapenna M, Faglioni F, Zanchetta F, Fioresi R
arxiv-2309-00699.description: Abstract We examine a Geometric Deep Learning model as a thermodynamic system treating the weights as non-quantum and non-relativistic particles. We employ the notion of temperature previously defined in [ 7 ] and study it in the various layers for GCN and GAT models. Potential future applications of our findings are discussed.

arxiv-2402-15042.title: Searching for Exotic Spin-Dependent Interactions with Diamond-Based Vector Magnetometer
arxiv-2402-15042.creator: Aolong Guo, Runqi Kang, Man Jiao, Xing Rong
arxiv-2402-15042.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Aolong Guo, Runqi Kang, Man Jiao, Xing Rong. We propose a new method to search for exotic spin-spin interactions between electrons and nucleons using a diamond-based vector magnetometer. The vector magnetometer can be constructed from ensembles of nitrogen-vacancy centers along different axes in a diamond. The N 14 {}^{14}\mathrm{N} nuclear spins of nitrogen-vacancy centers in the same diamond can be polarized through the dynamic nuclear polarization method to serve as spin sources.

arxiv-2504-05831.title: Leveraging Robust Optimization for LLM Alignment under Distribution Shifts
arxiv-2504-05831.creator: Mingye Zhu, Yi Liu, Zheren Fu, Yongdong Zhang Zhendong Mao
arxiv-2504-05831.description: Abstract Preference alignment methods are increasingly critical for steering large language models (LLMs) to generate outputs consistent with human values. While recent approaches often rely on synthetic data generated by LLMs for scalability and cost-efficiency reasons, this reliance can introduce distribution shifts that undermine the nuanced representation of human preferences needed for desirable outputs.

arxiv-2504-15171.title: Audio-Visual Class-Incremental Learning for Fish Feeding Intensity Assessment in Aquaculture
arxiv-2504-15171.creator: Meng Cui, Xianghu Yue, Xinyuan Qian, Jinzheng Zhao, Haohe Liu, Xubo Liu, Daoliang Li, Wenwu Wang
arxiv-2504-15171.description: Abstract Fish Feeding Intensity Assessment (FFIA) is crucial in industrial aquaculture management. Recent multi-modal approaches have shown promise in improving FFIA robustness and efficiency. However, these methods face significant challenges when adapting to new fish species or environments due to catastrophic forgetting and the lack of suitable datasets.

arxiv-2506-22694.title: VocabTrim : Vocabulary Pruning for Efficient Speculative Decoding in LLMs

arxiv-2509-10674.title: Using white dwarf lensing to resolve accretion flows 2023 Using white dwarf lensing to resolve accretion flows – 16
arxiv-2509-10674.creator: Sophie L. Newman, Matthew J. Middleton & \,\& Adam McMaster
arxiv-2509-10674.description: Abstract Microlensing is one of the most powerful tools for probing the nature of dark halo objects and the sources they lens. As our nearest massive galaxy, M31 provides a rich source population with many potential lenses in its halo crossing our field of view at any one time.

arxiv-2509-20978.title: FracAug: Fractional Augmentation boost Graph-level Anomaly Detection under Limited Supervision
arxiv-2509-20978.creator: Xiangyu Dong, Xingyi Zhang, Sibo Wang
arxiv-2509-20978.description: Abstract Graph-level anomaly detection (GAD) is critical in diverse domains such as drug discovery, yet high labeling costs and dataset imbalance hamper the performance of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). To address these issues, we propose FracAug, an innovative plug-in augmentation framework that enhances GNNs by generating semantically consistent graph variants and pseudo-labeling with mutual verification.

arxiv-2512-02013.title: ManualVLA: A Unified VLA Model for Chain-of-Thought Manual Generation and Robotic Manipulation
arxiv-2512-02013.creator: Chenyang Gu, Jiaming Liu, Hao Chen, Runzhong Huang, Qingpo Wuwu, Zhuoyang Liu, Xiaoqi Li, Ying Li, Renrui Zhang, Peng Jia, Pheng-Ann Heng, Shanghang Zhang, Peking University The Chinese University of Hong Kong Simplexity Robotics Project web page: https://sites.google.com/view/maunalvla
arxiv-2512-02013.description: Abstract Vision–Language–Action (VLA) models have recently emerged, demonstrating strong generalization in robotic scene understanding and manipulation. However, when confronted with long-horizon tasks that require defined goal states, such as LEGO assembly or object rearrangement, existing VLA models still face challenges in coordinating high-level planning with precise manipulation.

arxiv-2602-10740.title: Yuming Yan
arxiv-2602-10740.description: Abstract Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate remarkable general-purpose capabilities but often fall short in specialized domains such as medical imaging or geometric problem-solving. Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) can enhance performance within a target domain, but it typically causes catastrophic forgetting, limiting its utility as a general AI agent.

britannica-1911-smoke.description: Article 'Smoke' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Schmauch, probably allied to Gr. σμύχειν), the vapour or volatile matter which escapes from a burning substance during combustion, especially the visible vapour produced by the burning of coal, wood, peat or vegetable substances generally. In this article the various legislative and other measures recommended or adopted for the abating of the nuisance caused by the excessive production of smoke are dealt with.

pmc-10595713.creator: E Azria, P Sauvegrain, O Anselem, M P Bonnet, C Deneux-Tharaux, C Fischer, A Rousseau, J Richetin
pmc-10595713.description: BackgroundThe mechanisms of disparities in maternal and perinatal health between migrant and native women are multiple and remain poorly understood. One hypothesis is the existence of implicit biases among caregivers through which the women's ethno-racial belonging can influence medical decisions and engender healthcare disparities.

pmc-11327614.title: Direct and indirect effects of climate and seed dynamics on the breeding performance of a seed predator at the distribution edge
pmc-11327614.creator: Daniel Oro, Lídia Freixas, Carme Bartrina, Silvia Míguez, Ignasi Torre
pmc-11327614.description: Marginal populations usually have low densities and are considered to be particularly vulnerable to environmental stochasticity. Using data collected in nest boxes, we analyzed the breeding performance of the edible dormouse (Glis glis), an obligate hibernating rodent and a seed predator in deciduous forests, in two populations at the distribution range's edge.

pmc-11383762.creator: Hongmin Li, Jinyu Liang, Peifeng Li, Xiangzheng Li, Qing Liu, Songxue Yang, Chunlei Zhang, Shun Liu, Yuan He, Cheng Tan
pmc-11383762.description: ObjectiveSchizonepeta tenuifolia -Saposhnikovia divaricata (Jingjie-Fangfeng, JF) has been used for years to treat allergic inflammatory skin diseases like atopic dermatitis, but the specific effects and mechanisms of JF are still unclear.PurposeWe aim to investigate the therapeutic effect and mechanism of JF in MC903-induced atopic dermatitis-like model.MethodsJF decoction was subjected to rigorous HPLC and GC analysis.

pmc-12508595.title: Duchesnea indica (Andr.) Focke extracts exerted anti-inflammatory effect via inhibiting MAPK/ERK pathway in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 cells
pmc-12508595.creator: Haipeng Feng, Qianqian Qiao, Jingyan Zhang, Kang Zhang, Lei Wang, Jianxi Li
pmc-12508595.description: Duchesnea indica (Andr.) Focke (DIF), a medicinal plant from the Rosaceae family, possesses therapeutic properties such as heat-clearing and detoxification, dispersion of stasis detumescence, blood-cooling, and hemostatic effect. The latest research unveiled a diverse array of pharmacologically active compounds from DIF, showcasing a broad spectrum of pharmacological effects.

pmc-12533034.title: Biomechanical comparison of suture and screw fixation in PCL avulsion with variable bone quality
pmc-12533034.creator: Sorawut Thamyongkit, Pasit Komonsuwan, Benrita Jitaree, Panya Aroonjarattham, Nattawat Rattanapan, Chompunut Somtua, Nadhaporn Saengpetch
pmc-12533034.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Various fixation techniques, including screws and suture-based methods, are used for posterior cruciate ligament (PCL) avulsion fractures. This study compared the biomechanical effects of different suture configurations in simulated PCL avulsion fractures. Twenty cadaveric knees were assigned to four fixation groups: antegrade screw (A), 1 suture tape with 2 tunnels (B), 2 suture tapes with 2 tunnels (C), and 2 suture tapes with 3 tunnels (D).

pmc-12740715.title: Periostin Promotes Sarcoma Growth by Promoting Tumor-Associated Macrophage Migration and Differentiation
pmc-12740715.creator: Jin-Fen Xiao, Kristin Ishaya, Emily Y. Ko, Annaliese Fowler, Marina T. Broz, Jlenia Guarnerio
pmc-12740715.description: Soft-tissue sarcomas (STS) are characterized by abundant extracellular matrix (ECM) deposition, yet the functional contribution of specific ECM components remains poorly understood. In this study, we identify periostin (POSTN), a matricellular protein, as a regulator of sarcoma progression and the tumor immune microenvironment.

pmc-13091762.title: Composite disturbance observer-based sliding mode control strategies for unmanned surface vehicles with unmatched disturbances
pmc-13091762.creator: Yixin Su, Chenglong Gong, Zhengying Li, Danhong Zhang
pmc-13091762.description: SummaryUnmatched disturbances pose significant challenges to the control performance of unmanned surface vehicles (USVs), necessitating effective mitigation control strategies. This study proposes composite disturbance observer-based sliding mode control (SMC) strategies to address the trajectory tracking control problem of USVs under the influence of unmatched and matched disturbances, and input saturation.

pmc-13154106.title: Magnesium Sulfate as a Rescue Therapy for Refractory Unstable Supraventricular Tachycardia in the Emergency Department: A Case Report
pmc-13154106.creator: Nordia Thompson-Newell, Michelle Gordon Taylor, Shuvra Dasgupta
pmc-13154106.description: Refractory unstable supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) that is unresponsive to both chemical cardioversion and electrical cardioversion is a rare phenomenon that may lead to significant morbidity and mortality. For this subcategory of patients, there are no clear recommendations in the current American Heart Association (AHA)/American College of Cardiology (ACC)/European Society of Cardiology (ESC) guidelines for their management.

pmc-13370177.title: Associations of quality of social support with affective symptoms from midlife to later life: evidence from a British birth cohort
pmc-13370177.creator: Alexandra Schmidt, Ellen J. Thompson, Marcus Richards, Clara Strauss, Nick Grey, Darya Gaysina
pmc-13370177.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundQuality of social support is linked to mental health, but less is known about its long-term effects. We aimed to investigate the effects of the quality of social support on affective symptoms from midlife through later life.MethodsData were used from the MRC National Survey of Health and Development (NSHD), a prospective birth cohort originally consisting of 5,362 people born in 1946.

pmc-13435294.creator: Wyatt B David, Luke Sang, Hayden Sampson, Zachary Brumm, Stephanie E Wong, Alan L Zhang
pmc-13435294.description: PurposeTo assess the relationships between hip‐specific patient‐reported outcomes (PROs) metrics and general health and pain measures before and after hip arthroscopy for femoroacetabular impingement syndrome (FAIS).MethodsThis was a retrospective study of patients undergoing hip arthroscopy for FAIS at a single institution from 2014 to 2025.

pmc-13674642.creator: Sujia Hu, Xingyang Zhao, Yichun Cheng, Shuwang Ge
pmc-13674642.description: Acute Kidney Disease (AKD) is defined as acute kidney injury (AKI) persisting for 7 to 90 days and represents a window for interventions to improve renal outcomes. This retrospective cohort study at Tongji Hospital, China, included 23,868 adult patients who survived at least one AKI episode between January 2015 and April 2024.
